column3: With respect to the CVS-Walgreens Portfolio Mortgage Loan (3.5%), Walgreen Co., the sole tenant at the Walgreens Ellicott City Mortgaged Property, has a termination option which may be exercised every five years, beginning in 2035 and concluding in 2085, provided that the tenant gives at least 12 month’s prior written notice of its intention to terminate its lease.
